admission_scope: These exact hashes only: unchanged public thermal prototype under a conditional policy-eligible industrial account's published monthly TOU energy charges. Not a real account/building/device, grid design, BESTEST certification or life-cycle economic result.

time_scope.identity: borrowed Wuchang/surrounding-area 2024 government-news service window; not citywide law

NASA.identity: NASA POWER gridded MERRA2/SYN1DEG product, UTC hourly; not station measurement

GRID.identity: 2023 Hubei province annual-average electricity CO2 factor, table 3; reference applied to 2024/25

WINDOW.identity: Wuhan government news, 2024-11-17: Wuchang and surrounding district 11/16 to 3/15; borrowed experiment window, not citywide statutory season

PROTOCOL.identity: Explicit model boundary/derived convention; not measured data

TOU_NOV.identity: 2024-11, PDF p1, single-part industrial/commercial <1kV row and footnotes 1-3; government repost of State Grid notice

TOU_DEC.identity: 2024-12, PDF p1, same row and footnotes; government repost of State Grid notice

TOU_2025.identity: State Grid Hubei official 2025 combined notice: Jan p12, Feb p11, Mar p10; same row and footnotes; document order is reversed

POLICY77.identity: Stamped original E-fagai-jiaguan [2024]77 government repost: PDF p2 scope/hours/coefficients, p3 effective 2024-05-01

POLICY163.identity: Stamped original E-fagai-jiaguan [2023]163 government repost: PDF p2 clause4 single/two-part account scope and minimum 12-month selection period

tariff_account_and_hours.identity: Conditional public tariff-class experiment; no actual billing account observation
tariff_account_and_hours.selected_class: Ordinary State Grid Hubei industrial/commercial agent-purchase, single-part, billing supply voltage <1kV
conditional_policy_requirements: Industrial/commercial account in the Hubei grid with registered supply capacity >=100kVA and <315kVA; single-part selected for a period of at least 12 months
Not railway traction, commercial electricity, government/military/school/hospital/public-lighting or another non-residential-lighting exclusion; no separate special-policy exception is assumed

Ordinary agent-purchase category; not unjustified return from direct market trading, coal captive-plant users or temporarily ineligible high-energy-consuming users subject to 1.5x agent generation price
<1kV is the electricity-billing supply voltage, not an appliance secondary-side 380V label
tariff_account_and_hours.capacity_identity: The policy capacity interval is only a conditional account criterion, not a claimed transformer rating, added model parameter or grid capacity constraint. The model's 1000kW is an ideal BESTEST numerical upper bound, not contracted power. Actual connection and power factor remain unverified.
tariff_account_and_hours.storage_exception: No eligibility inferred from the core electric_boiler adapter: it represents an ideal air benchmark, not an actual electric storage boiler. No heat pump or tank is added.
tariff_account_and_hours.interval_convention: Each hourly timestamp labels [timestamp,timestamp+1h); local half-open intervals, no DST

coefficient_context_only.rule: Published complete rates used directly; these multipliers are NOT applied again to energy-charge columns

tariff_account_and_hours.billing_scope: Published monthly energy charges including published line-loss, transmission/distribution, government-fund and system-operation components. Single-part selected row has no capacity/demand basic-charge column. Power-factor adjustment, other reactive penalties, actual settlement corrections, taxes outside published columns, contract fees and other services are outside the experiment.

structure_approximations: H retains original prescribed high-altitude infiltration; Wuhan weather replacement does not make this a local building
Inner-side material capacity is lumped into one air/zone state; no measured effective RC C or predictive accuracy claim
No solar gains, latent loads, domestic hot water, thermal bridges, occupancy-based behavior or ground dynamics
Ideal 1000kW 100%-efficient benchmark air system, no finite emitter/COP curve or actual rated equipment claim
27C delivery tag is maximum-zone-bound ideal accounting convention, not a reported outlet temperature; exergy efficacy out of scope
20C initial and terminal conditioned boundary; preconditioning outside seasonal accounting
Shared ideal heating/cooling capacity with exclusive RC operation; no real compressor asset claimed
economic_scope: 2880-hour reference operating electricity energy charges and fixed-factor emissions only; no observed account settlement, capacity/demand fee, power-factor adjustment, CAPEX/OM/life/discounted cash-flow/frontier claim

inactive_interface_fields.reason: required constructor arithmetic only; all investment/retirement disabled; never use for financial claims

checks.full_solver_run: owned by integration runner; record code/input freeze independently
